title: ExecutePaymentPayload
description: Payload schema for the EXECUTE_PAYMENT intent. Carries the data needed to execute a tokenized payment against an approved purchase. Never contains raw card data.

request_id.description: Identifier of the upstream purchase request being paid (e.g. 'pr-2026-001').

amount.description: Payment amount. Must be positive. Decimals up to 2 places.

vendor_or_payee.description: Recipient of the payment. Must match an existing vendor record for any first-time payment over the vendor-risk-review threshold.

payment_method.description: Tokenized payment method reference. Must NOT contain raw PAN, CVV, or bank account numbers. Examples: 'virtual_card_token_abc', 'ach_token_xyz', 'wire_token_123'.

approved_by.description: Ordered list of approver IDs whose approvals authorize this payment. Length and contents must satisfy the policy threshold for the amount.

business_id.description: Business unit / cost center the payment posts against.

scheduled_for.description: Optional UTC timestamp for delayed/scheduled execution. If omitted, execute immediately.

invoice_ref.description: Optional invoice identifier the payment satisfies.

memo.description: Optional free-text memo carried with the payment.
